title: Shopping scams: how to spot them and save money | Kaspersky official blog
description: This report from Kaspersky details common scams associated with Black Friday shopping, including fake discounts, scam websites, phishing sites impersonating legitimate retailers, and AI-generated fake products. Cybercriminals exploit the shopping frenzy to steal money and sensitive personal information, sometimes delivering nothing or counterfeit goods. Phishing sites may also trick users into downloading malware disguised as legitimate files or apps. The report provides advice on how to identify scams, such as checking domain registration dates, verifying prices, looking for legitimate store addresses, and ensuring HTTPS usage. It also warns about AI-generated influencers and products that do not exist. Kaspersky Premium is recommended as a protective solution against these threats.
